Method of Attack: Malicious Chrome browser extension acting as a remote access trojan (RAT) for Chromium browsers
Steals online accounts by stealing cookies
Injects ads by silently loading webpages to generate ad impressions
Enlists victim's browser in layer 7 DDoS attacks via HTTP POST requests
Monitors clipboard for copied passwords or credit cards via clipper module
Loads exploits for multiple CVEs to install Windows malware for further system compromise
Impacted Systems: Chromium web browsers including Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge
Windows systems (via exploits and malware installation)
Firefox and Internet Explorer (via exploits loaded by the extension)
Attack Vector: Malicious Chrome extension distributed through alternative channels such as fake Adobe Flash Player update websites
Indicators of Compromise: C2 domains linked to Keksec malware group
Exploits for CVE-2019-11708, CVE-2019-9810 (Firefox), CVE-2014-6332, CVE-2016-0189 (Internet Explorer), CVE-2016-7200 (Edge)
Screenshots posted by threat actors on forums
